entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with T.R. Case No.160 of 2024 pending on the file of learned District & Sessions Judge-cum- Special Judge, Kendrapara, arising out of Derabish P.S. Case No.117 of 2024 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 498-A/294/366/302/304- B/376-D/376(1) & (2)/506/34 of IPC read with Sections 3(1)/3(1)(s)/3(2)(va) of SC & ST (POA)Act.
3.

entities.text: District & Sessions Judge-cum- Special Judge, Kendrapara
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that in the meanwhile charge sheet has already been submitted, wherein petitioner nos.1 & 2, who are the father-in-law and brother-in-law of the deceased respectively, have not been charge sheeted.

It is further submitted that after investigation, though the petitioners were not charge sheeted, yet there is perceptible threat of arrest since the instigation has been kept open in respect of the petitioners.
It is further submitted that in the meanwhile, the husband, who was taken into custody, has already been released on bail in CRLA No.1318 of 2024 by order dated 7.3.2025.
Hence, the pre-arrest bail may be granted to the petitioners.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposed to such prayer, inter alia, submitting that since the petitioners have not been charge sheeted, there is no perceptible threat of arrest.

entities.text: Bhramarabar Behera vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Taking into account the nature of allegations and that the petitioners are ladies and charge sheet has already been filed and investigation has been kept open, this Court finds force in the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners that there is threat of arrest.

Taking into account the release of the husband, as noted above, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the petitioners nos.1 & 2, namely, Bhramarabar Behera and Babu Behera respectively in connection with the aforesaid case, they shall be released on bail by the Arresting Officer on such terms and conditions deemed just and proper with further conditions that they will cooperate with the investigation.
6. Violation of any of the above condition(s) shall entail cancellation of bail.
7. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
8. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Manoj Designation: AR-CUM-SENIOR SECRETARY Bhramarabar Behera vs State Of Odisha ....
